source_review.notes: Reviewed current Eiffel, OpenJML, Dafny, C++ draft, Java SE 25, Rust, Python and SEI CERT documentation plus the primary Hoare and Liskov-Wing papers. Nine destinations returned HTTP 200; the ACM DOI resolved to an access-controlled 403 page while bibliographic identity was independently verified.

evidence: Checked operation relation, Hoare triple, old/primed state, frame formula, totalized outcomes, histories and resource parameters.
Separated representation invariants, abstract transitions, results, errors, frames, resources and concurrency.
notation_and_syntax.notes: All variables and scope-dependent guarantees are declared.

evidence: Recomputed capacity-two deque spans and states across two pushes, full rejection, two pops and empty rejection.
Verified every printed snapshot and Boolean against the exact execution report.
numerical_recomputation.notes: One finite trace is calibration only.

evidence: Derived set insertion result and map frame equations.
Derived queue totalization and geometric-array worst-case versus amortized bounds.
Checked strong failure guarantee at abstract rather than byte-identical state.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No universal implementation proof is claimed.

evidence: Reviewed empty/full, invalid domains, sentinel collision, duplicates, NaN ordering, callback failure/reentrancy, allocation, cancellation and corruption.
Reviewed aliases, mutable keys, stale iterators, adversarial hashing, concurrency races, persistence, overflow and high-stakes scheduling.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Ordinary outcomes and defects remain distinct.

evidence: Normal and failure outcomes preserve the declared abstract frame and representation validity.
Aliases and invalidation cannot silently bypass operation authority under the stated ownership contract.
Complexity and concurrency guarantees name assumptions and observation models.
invariant_checking.notes: Invariant preservation alone is explicitly insufficient for transition correctness.

evidence: Reviewed normal correctness obligations for precondition, termination, successor invariant, result, correspondence and frame.
Reviewed failure correctness per failure point and totalization of empty/full outcomes.
Reviewed replacement comparison across domains, outputs, errors, aliases, order, resources and histories.
proof_review.notes: Proof structures are manual and scoped.

evidence: Aliasing, resources, concurrency and replacement sections state premises and deferred proof needs.
Radiation scheduling example names independent domain and safety reviews and disclaims approval.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No verification, certification or deployment fitness is inferred.

evidence: Python snippet passed exact five-line stdout, empty stderr and zero exit status.
Nine sources were directly retrieved and the ACM access-control limitation recorded.
Snippet prose explicitly limits evidence to one capacity and trace.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No concurrent, persistent, fault-injected or high-stakes system was run.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed preconditions, normal/error outcomes, frames, totalization, failure atomicity, ownership, invalidation, iteration, costs, callbacks, concurrency, persistence and subtyping.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementable API choices, snapshot testing, fault injection, reference-model traces, adversarial assumptions, compatibility and migration surfaces.

pedagogical_review.notes: Builds on DSE-001/002 without duplication, uses one exact executable model, counters fourteen misconceptions, supplies ten worked examples and five matched exercises/answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external language, library, concurrency, security, clinical, radiation-safety, regulatory, quality or independent review is claimed. The chapter and finite trace prove neither arbitrary implementation compliance, real-time behavior, linearizability, safety, certification nor deployment fitness.
